page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head at top with page number left. Continuation lines of previous letter, then dateline, then a rule, chapter number, title block, salutation in italic, and the opening paragraph with a large initial C. Notes: none in margins.

main_text.p: stissimos Deus ille prouehet, a quo ut Celsitudinem V. salvam & incolumem tueatur etiam atque etiam peto.
main_text.head: XXIII. EPISTOLA HENRICI REGIS AD SUEC. REGEM.
main_text.p: CUm a multis jam annis Ecclesiæ nostræ bello Gallico Civili jactatæ fuerint, neque tantisper dum premerentur, ab iis defendendis vacuum ullum tempus nobis concessum fuerit, summo cum mærore nostro

page.notes: The initial C is a large woodcut letter joined to "Um". Some letters in the upper lines are damaged by the scan (for example "stissimos" at the line start, probably "Pietatis" or "Optimus" type word with "Ch" missing; read as printed). The rule and chapter numeral are decorative separators. Spelling uses long s rendered as plain s.
